msgTrainDescription: Please select a model type, and choose the tabular dataset to train. After training, the model file will be downloaded automatically, and show metrics such as XAI.
msgTrainNoteXgb1: : Number of boosting rounds. Higher values may cause overfitting.
msgTrainNoteXgb2: : Step size shrinkage used to prevent overfitting.
msgTrainNoteXgb3: : Maximum depth of a tree. Higher values increase model complexity.
msgTrainNoteLgbm3: : Maximum tree depth. Set -1 for no limit.
msgTrainNoteLgbm4: : Maximum number of leaves per tree.
msgTrainNoteRf1: The algorithm trains multiple independent decision trees simultaneously. Therefore it cannot generate loss or accuracy curves over epochs.
msgTrainNoteRf2: : Number of trees in the forest.
msgTrainNoteRf5: : Number of parallel jobs. -1 means use all processors.
msgTrainNotelr2: : Inverse of regularization strength. Smaller values mean stronger regularization.
msgTrainNoteTabnet1: To speed up interpretation, SHAP for TabNet uses only the first 20 samples as background and explains the first 5.
msgTrainNoteTabnet4: : Number of epochs to wait before early stopping.
msgTabpfnModelVersionHint: Model version: selects between different pretrained TabPFN checkpoints; default (v2.5) is recommended for most experiments.
msgTrainNoteTabpfn1: TabPFN uses a pretrained Transformer and does not update weights over traditional epochs; instead it performs one-shot inference on the full training dataset.
msgTrainNoteTabpfn2: In this system we use the official pretrained checkpoints (model_version such as default / v2), which can be seen as different TabPFN variants for comparison.
msgTrainNoteTabpfn3: Since TabPFN has no traditional training process, this system presents a 'Decision Threshold Analysis': showing accuracy and error rate changes across different thresholds (0.01–1.00) to help you select the optimal decision threshold.
msgTrainNoteTabpfn4: : Number of repeated inference configurations (preprocessing/rotation combinations) used as TabPFN ensemble members. Leave empty for default value means using the default setting. Recommended practical range is 4–16, with a limit of 32
msgTrainNoteMlp1: : Neuron count in the first hidden layer.
msgTrainNoteMlp2: : Optional neuron count in the second hidden layer.
msgTrainNoteMlp3: : Third hidden layer. Requires the second to be filled.
msgTrainNoteMlp7: : Stop training early if validation accuracy does not improve for several iterations.
msgTrainNoteMlp8: Validation results used for plotting come from MLPClassifier's internal split. Custom validation sets (train_test_split) are not supported.
msgTrainNoteMlp9: Only training loss and validation accuracy can be plotted. Training accuracy and validation loss are unavailable.
msgTrainNoteMlp10: To speed up interpretation, SHAP for Multi-Layer Perceptron uses only the first 20 samples as background and explains the first 5.

msgSyntheticDescription: Generate high-quality synthetic tabular data using deep learning generators with comprehensive quality assessment (Fidelity / Privacy / Utility)
msgLabelColumnHint: Select ONLY ONE label column for grouped training and ML Efficacy evaluation
msgCtganDescription: CTGAN uses Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks, learning data distributions through adversarial training between Generator and Discriminator. Suitable for mixed-type tabular data.
msgTvaeDescription: TVAE uses Variational Autoencoder, encoding data into latent space and decoding to generate. More stable training, suitable for data with many columns.
msgTabddpmDescription: TabDDPM uses Diffusion Models for tabular data generation, with more stable training compared to GAN/VAE.
msgSyntheticNoteEpochs: : Training iterations. CTGAN paper default: 2000~3000, TVAE: 5000.
msgSyntheticNoteBatchSize: : Samples per batch, default 500. Recommend 1/10 ~ 1/5 of data size.
msgFidelityExplain: Higher Single/Multi Column Similarity is better (close to 100% means similar distributions); Lower KL/JS Divergence is better (close to 0 means consistent distributions)
msgPrivacyExplain: Higher DCR Baseline Protection score means greater distance between synthetic and real data, better privacy protection. Score > 50% indicates synthetic data is less likely to leak privacy than random data.
msgDiscriminatorExplain: Discriminator Measure tests if classifiers can distinguish real from synthetic data. Accuracy closer to 50% means harder to distinguish, indicating better synthetic data quality.
msgMLEfficacyExplain: ML Efficacy compares model performance when trained on real data (Baseline) vs synthetic data (TSTR). TSTR metrics closer to Baseline indicate higher practical value of synthetic data.

msgSyntheticSuccess: Synthetic data generation completed! Please check the evaluation results below.
msgTrainModeHint: Grouped training trains separate generators for each class, producing higher quality synthetic data. Supports multi-class classification.
msgLearningRateHint: Default: gen_lr=0.0002, disc_lr=0.0002. Auto params adjusts dynamically based on class sample size.
msgTGANTHint: TGANT iteratively filters synthetic samples until all classes reach the threshold. Supports 2~N class classification.
msgTGANTMetricHint: min = all classes must reach threshold (strict); macro = average reach threshold (relaxed)
msgTGANTGenerateHint: Generate specified multiplier of samples first, then iteratively filter to get high-quality samples.
msgTGANTNumSamplesHint: With TGANT enabled, the system will iteratively filter synthetic samples that meet quality standards.
lblUseAutoParams: Auto-adjust params by class sample size
msgColumnConstraintsHint: Specify generation ranges or allowed values for specific columns. Training data will be pre-filtered and generated data will be validated to ensure compliance.
msgConstraintLimitation: Generator models (CTGAN / TVAE / TabDDPM) can only learn from the original data distribution. They cannot produce categories that don't exist in the source or numeric values outside the original range. Column constraints can only narrow the range (subset of existing distribution), not extend it. Please select values or ranges that actually exist in the source data.
msgConstraintOutOfRange: {values} is outside the original range of {col} [{origMin}, {origMax}]. Generator models cannot extrapolate; post-filter clip will force all values to the boundary, destroying data quality. Please adjust to within the original range.
msgConstraintRangeRequired: Please specify at least minimum or maximum
msgConstraintMinMaxInvalid: Minimum cannot be greater than maximum
msgConstraintOptionsRequired: Please select at least one allowed value
msgConditionalRulesHint: Set conditional constraints. For example: 'If gender is F, then age must be in [18, 65]'. The constraint applies only when the condition is met.
msgConditionalIncomplete: Please complete both the condition and the constraint
msgWhenValuesRequired: Please select at least one condition value
msgDdpmDeviationNote: The backend will respect your input, but quality may be below the paper baseline. Recommended: enable Auto Params or use the paper-recommended values.
msgDdpmWarnNiter: n_iter={value} is below the paper minimum of 5000 (Table 1: 5000/10000/20000)
msgDdpmWarnBatch: batch_size={value} is not a paper-recommended value (Table 1: 256 or 4096)
msgDdpmWarnTimesteps: num_timesteps={value} is not a paper-recommended value (Table 1: 100 or 1000)
msgParamEpochsDesc: GAN training epochs. Auto params adjusts dynamically based on class sample size.
msgParamBatchSizeDesc: Samples per batch. Default 500, recommend 1/10 ~ 1/5 of data size.
msgParamDiscStepsDesc: Discriminator steps per Generator update. Default 1.
msgParamLrDesc: Learning rate. Auto params adjusts based on class sample size.
msgParamDimDesc: Hidden layer dimensions. Classes with more samples use smaller networks.
msgParamTgantDesc: Iteratively filter synthetic samples. Stop condition: Recall >= 95% (both TRTS and TSTR).
msgRegularizationHint: Default: l2scale=1e-5, loss_factor=2. Controls model regularization.
msgParamTvaeEpochsDesc: VAE training epochs. Auto params adjusts based on class sample size.
msgParamTvaeDimDesc: Encoder/Decoder hidden dimensions. Classes with more samples use smaller networks.
msgParamRegularizationDesc: L2 regularization and reconstruction loss weights. Controls model complexity and generation quality.
msgParamCtganPaperRef: Based on: CTGAN (NeurIPS 2019) + SDV Best Practices
msgParamTvaePaperRef: Based on: TVAE (NeurIPS 2019) + SDV Best Practices
